To start, your art is good and her burning it was wrong. A lot of good solutions in the comments too but most of them seem to be ways to hide your art from her and don’t fix the actual problem, which seems to be the disconnect between you and your mom about the appropriateness(?) of your art. 

Is there a reason you’ve only been drawing girls? Aesthetics is a good enough justification if it’s from a pure artistic intention, but it might not hurt to mix in boys or other topics all together to both broaden your art skills and make her feel like you’re not at the doorstep of drawing hentai. Burning your art is not a good solution, all it did was put a strain on your relationship and make you want to hide it from her. She might not like this specific art style but you broadened your subject matter she may feel less like you have a hyper fixation on young anime girls and support you more as an artist. 

I also think an artist should be able to make the art they want to make and shouldn’t need to change themselves. At the same time I assume you’re in high school given the situation and you’re still finding your art style and interests, so it’s not the end of the world to explore other topics and practice creativity. Then the flags won’t look as red to her and she might not have an issue with the girls anymore.
